subject: general
question:
Refer to the given letter, number, symbol series and answer the question that follows.

(Left) D 4 & A $ Z G 7 R 5 % W 2 @ 3 # V 6 & F Y (Right)

If all the numbers are dropped from the series, which of the following will be seventh from the right?
solution:
Given Number- (Left) D 4 & A $ Z G 7 R 5 % W 2 @ 3 # V 6 & F Y (Right)

If all the numbers are dropped from the series.

**(Left) D & $ Z G R % W @ # V & F Y (Right)**

Seventh from the right—(left) D & $ Z G R % __W__ @ # V & F Y (Right)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
